description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in, and a verified referrer account. Takes an open referral request for the signed-in referrer. The candidate is told a referrer is looking at it. Then mark_referral_request_referred once submitted, or release_referral_request / decline_referral_request.
name: claim_referral_request

action.description: The action that was applied: claim, release, referred, decline or request_changes.
